template.name: Permanent Castable for {C}
template.scryfallQuery: mv<=1 (mana={0} or mana={1} or mana={C}) is:permanent

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C} {C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C} by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}. 
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast by paying {0}, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}.

almostIncluded.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tivit.
Tivit triggers, causing you to create at least five in any combination of Clue and/or Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn until you have two or less opponents remaining.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
An opponent cannot block Tivit.

feature.name: Infinite mana artifacts you control can produce

almostIncluded.description:
Deal combat damage with Brago.
Brago triggers.
In response, activate artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping itself, copying Brago's triggered ability.
Resolve the copied triggered ability, blinking Strionic Resonator, the artifacts that tapped for mana, and any number of nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
You control artifacts that can tap to add at least {2}.
Brago does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block and kill Brago.

almostIncluded.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Quietus Spike attached.
Quietus Spike triggers, causing the defending opponent to lose their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Quietus Spike attached to a creature you control that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.

almostIncluded.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Quietus Spike attached.
Quietus Spike triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
Quietus Spike attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill the creature with Quietus Spike attached.

feature.name: Infinite colored mana if your opponent allows it
Infinite Treasure and/or Clue tokens of your opponents' choosing

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Tivit by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Tivit enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Tivit trigger, creating at least two Treasure tokens and at least one additional Clue or Treasure token of your opponent' choosing.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Tivit.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Tivit.

feature.name: Infinite mana nonland permanents you control can produce
Infinite untap of nonland permanents you control

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Unstoppable Plan triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of other nonland permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Unstoppable Plan's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Unstoppable Plan's trigger, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 2.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}.

At the beginning of your end step, Astarion triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Quietus Spike attached to any creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.

Quietus Spike triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice Second Chance and take an extra turn.
Attack with Sun Titan, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
You have 5 or less life.
Opponents can not kill Sun Titan when you attack.
Sun Titan does not have summoning sickness.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature or artifact.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Stolen Identity, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Stolen Identity, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
almostIncluded.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
There is a creature or artifact on the battlefield.
You have enough mana to cast Stolen Identity

feature.name: Infinite untap of permanents you control
Infinite mana permanents you control can produce

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Sands of Time triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Sands of Time's ability.
Resolve the copy of Sands of Time's ability, untapping all tapped artifacts, creatures and lands you control and tapping all untapped artifacts, creatures, and lands you control.
Repeat from step 2.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.
almostIncluded.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Cephalid Facetaker triggers, causing it to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate Cephalid Facetaker by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Cephalid Facetaker into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Jumbo Cactuar and causing you to gain 10,000 life.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.

feature.name: From now on, destroy any creatures opponents control at instant speed

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target creature.
That creature dies from lethal damage due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch ability.
Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for each creature opponents control and whenever an opponent controls a creature.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Quietus Spike attached to Goblin Sharpshooter.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.

feature.name: Destroy each creature that enters the battlefield under an opponent's control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to Deathbringer Thoctar's deathtouch.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Quietus Spike attached to Deathbringer Thoctar.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature or artifact.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Stolen Identity, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Stolen Identity, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
There is an artifact or creature on the battlefield.
You have enough mana to cast Stolen Identity

almostIncludedByAddingColors.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Cast Austere Command by paying its mana cost, destroying all creatures.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
